title: Glimpse of Da Nang and Hoi An with FREE Golden Hand Bridge Visit
highlights: Discover Da Nang and Hoi An's culture and natural beauty, from the breathtaking Ba Na Hills and historic Hoi An landmarks to a unique bamboo basket boat ride.
Enjoy a stunning cable car ride to Ba Na Hills, explore the Golden Hand Bridge, lush gardens, and Linh Ung Pagoda.
Discover the charm of Hoi An with visits to the Japanese Covered Bridge, Sa Huynh Museum, and lively Central Market.
Float through Cam Thanh’s coconut forests in a bamboo basket boat and learn local fishing traditions witnessing the fisherman’s daily lifestyle.
Watch artisans at work in the Silkworm and Handicraft Workshop in Hoi An, and immerse yourself in the town's rich history and vibrant culture.

Enjoy the amazing views of the landscape and enjoy the open view of the oceans

days.title: Arrival in Da Nang
days.desc: Welcome to Da Nang! Once you arrive at the airport, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. You can relax for the day or explore the city on your own. You can visit the Museum of Cham Sculpture dedicated to the indigenous people of Vietnam or The Marble Mountains which is a cluster of five hills. You can also spend a peaceful evening at Bai Nam & Bai Con Beach and so on. Later, head back to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ba Na Hills With Golden Hand Bridge
days.desc: Begin your Ba Na Hill adventure with a comfortable transfer from your hotel. Enjoy the breathtaking cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station. Upon arrival, visit the Golden Hand Bridge and wander through the picturesque gardens of Le Jardin D'Amour. Explore the serene Linh Ung Pagoda, and visit the historic Debay Wine Cellar. Afterwards, return via cable car and head back to your hotel with the provided transfer for an overnight stay.

days.title: Cam Thanh Basket Boat Trip
days.desc: Take the provided transfer from the hotel and head to the Cam Thanh fishing village. Here, you will meet friendly local fishermen and get a glimpse into their everyday lives. Hop into a traditional bamboo basket boat and float through the lush water coconut forest. After a visit to a local fisherman’s house, get transferred back to your hotel. Afterwards, you can relax or spend your free time exploring My Khe Beach or Dragon Bridge. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
